title: Usage-tethered add-on experiment: observability retention + compliance pack + premium SLA
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a controlled experiment that bundles two opt-in add-ons (extended observability retention and a compliance pack) with an optional premium SLA. The experiment will test a usage-tethered pricing model (per-GB retention + monthly seat or per-contract uplift) and a contract/onboarding flow that includes a shortened security questionnaire mapping for quick enterprise procurement.
hypothesis: If we offer a usage-linked observability retention add-on (charged by stored GB-days) combined with a compliance pack (audit logs, SOC2 artifact bundle) and a clearly priced premium SLA, enterprise teams will adopt at a >8% attach rate within 90 days and show >12% increase in ARPU without increasing churn more than 2%.
metrics: sales_cycle_reduction: target >= 10% for customers requiring compliance docs
payback_period: target <= 90 days for uplifted contracts
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (lab): define pricing model and billing backend mappings - 2 weeks
Phase 1 (pilot): enable for sales-assisted customers (10 customers) with manual contract templates - 6 weeks
Phase 2 (scaled experiment): open to self-serve teams behind feature flag (segment by ARR and industry) - 8 weeks
Phase 3: evaluate telemetry and decide on GA or iterate
billing_integration: map observability retention to metric: gb_days_stored
implement meter in usage pipeline and expose to billing (Stripe/Zuora hooks)
allow per-customer price overrides for Dedicated/Private accounts
contract_and_sales_playbook: pre-approved clause for premium SLA with 99.9% uptime and credits formula
one-page compliance addendum that maps Redwood artifacts to standard questions (SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS integration)
sales checklist: security questionnaire pushdown, legal signoff thresholds, discount caps for pilot
security_questionnaire_flow: short-path SQ for customers opting into compliance pack (10 core Qs + link to artifact bundle)
auto-generate artifact package link after purchase and include in contract deliverables
track SQ completions as lead scoring signal for sales
acceptance_criteria: Billing emits gb_days_stored metric and shows on invoice preview for pilot customers
Console shows retention tier selector and estimated monthly cost before purchase
Security questionnaire short-path linked and artifact bundle downloadable post-purchase
Sales can attach compliance addendum during contract creation and apply SLA pricing line items
risks: metering accuracy for gb_days_stored across Dedicated/private deployments
legal pushback on standard SLA liability caps
complexity for self-serve UX causing drop in purchase conversion
security review timeline may extend pilot start
notes: Sample SLA clause: 'Service Credits will be applied for monthly uptime below 99.9% as specified in Appendix A'
